requests.prompt: Which simulation models do you have?
requests.expected: Lists MBEV, FirstEV and HelloEV with a one-line description each.
requests.pass_if: All three named; MBEV described as a battery EV on NEDC.

requests.prompt: Which model should I use to look at an electric car on the NEDC drive cycle?
requests.expected: MBEV.
requests.pass_if: Recommends MBEV and says why (battery EV, one NEDC).

requests.prompt: Which battery-related signals can I look at in MBEV?
requests.expected: Recommended glossary signals: battery SOC, voltage, current, power, energy used, losses.
requests.pass_if: Lists at least SOC, voltage, current; uses glossary names, not internal connector signals.

requests.prompt: How long is a standard MBEV run, and why?
requests.expected: 1180 s, exactly one NEDC.
requests.pass_if: States 1180 s and links it to one NEDC.

requests.prompt: What versions of OpenModelica and Python is the simulation environment running?
requests.expected: OpenModelica 1.27.1, Python 3.10.12.
requests.pass_if: Both versions correct.

requests.prompt: Run the MBEV model.
requests.expected: New run, success, 1180 s; summary with final SOC ~67.1 %, top speed ~116.6 km/h; start-up message called harmless.
requests.pass_if: Run succeeds; reports run id; does not treat the structural-singular message as a problem.

requests.prompt: Simulate FirstEV and tell me its top speed in km/h.
requests.expected: Runs FirstEV (200 s) and reports max speed from the summary in km/h.
requests.pass_if: Run succeeds; number comes from the tool result (check against run data).
requests.notes: Ground truth: check the new FirstEV run's velSens.v max x 3.6.

requests.prompt: Run HelloEV for 100 seconds and tell me its final speed in km/h.
requests.expected: Runs HelloEV with stop_time 100; final speed from summary (km/h).
requests.pass_if: stop_time=100 used; number from tool result.
requests.notes: Ground truth: check the run's v end x 3.6.

requests.prompt: Run MBEV for only the first 600 seconds.
requests.expected: Run with stop_time 600 (urban part only).
requests.pass_if: stop_time=600 used; reports run id and summary.

requests.prompt: Run MBEV for 30,000 seconds.
requests.expected: Refused by guardrail (max 20,000 s); explains limit and suggests the standard run.
requests.pass_if: Does not run; explains the limit clearly.

requests.prompt: What was the final battery SOC in the last MBEV run, in percent?
requests.pass_if: Within ±0.1 %; names the run.
requests.notes: Ground truth from 20261107-203529_MBEV. If the latest run is the 1400 s one, 66.9 % is correct for that run.

requests.prompt: What was the lowest SOC in the last MBEV run, and when?
requests.expected: 66.8 % at about 1127 s.
requests.pass_if: Value ±0.1 % and time ±5 s.

requests.prompt: What was MBEV's top speed in km/h, and at what time?
requests.expected: 116.6 km/h at about 1126.5 s.
requests.pass_if: Value ±0.5 km/h; time ±5 s.

requests.prompt: How far did the car travel in the last MBEV run?
How much battery energy did MBEV use over the cycle?
requests.expected: 1.093 kWh (net).
requests.pass_if: ±0.01 kWh; in kWh.

requests.prompt: What is MBEV's energy consumption in Wh/km?
requests.pass_if: ±1 Wh/km; shows the calculation or both inputs.

requests.prompt: What was the maximum motor torque?
requests.expected: 142.6 N·m driving; −150 N·m braking (limit 150 N·m).
requests.pass_if: Uses eleDrive.tauElectrical (not driver.accelTau / 219.9).
requests.notes: Glossary trap: the torque request peaks at 219.8 N·m.

requests.prompt: What was the peak battery current, and is that charging or discharging?
requests.expected: +65.0 A discharging; −40.5 A charging (regen).
requests.pass_if: Uses batt1.n.i with correct sign meaning.

requests.prompt: What range did the battery voltage move within?
What was the maximum motor speed in rpm?
requests.expected: About 3,247 rpm.
requests.pass_if: ±20 rpm; in rpm.

requests.prompt: What was the SOC at 600 seconds?
Compare energy consumption in the urban and extra-urban parts of the NEDC.
requests.expected: Urban (0–780 s): 0.303 kWh / 3.95 km ≈ 77 Wh/km; extra-urban: 0.790 kWh / 6.80 km ≈ 116 Wh/km.
requests.pass_if: Both values within ±5 %; uses value at ~780 s (at_time) rather than guessing.
requests.notes: Needs read_results with at_time=780 or similar.

requests.prompt: Why doesn't the car reach the 120 km/h the cycle asks for?
requests.expected: Power-limited: battery/drive power capped at 25 kW; actual max 116.6 km/h vs target 120; biggest gap ~7.9 km/h at ~1116 s.
requests.pass_if: Identifies the power limit with evidence (25 kW reached), not a guess.

requests.prompt: Was the motor ever torque-limited? When?
requests.expected: Yes: hits the −150 N·m limit while braking; driving torque peaks 142.6 N·m (requests up to 219.8 N·m are cut).
requests.pass_if: Compares request vs actual torque or limit; no invented times.

requests.prompt: How much energy was lost inside the battery, as a share of the energy used?
requests.pass_if: Value ±0.005 kWh and share ±1 %.

requests.prompt: Based on this run, roughly what is the battery capacity?
requests.expected: ≈ 37 kWh: 1.093 kWh used for a 2.93 % SOC drop (assumes SOC linear in energy; model facts suggest ~38.7 kWh).
requests.pass_if: Shows the method and states the assumption; 35–40 kWh accepted.

requests.prompt: Plot actual speed and target speed for the last MBEV run.
requests.expected: Chart with velSens.v and driver.from_kmh.y in one panel.
requests.pass_if: Both correct signals; chart shown.

requests.prompt: Plot SOC for the last MBEV run.
requests.expected: Chart of batt1.SOC.
requests.pass_if: Correct signal; chart shown.

requests.prompt: Plot motor torque and battery current.
requests.expected: eleDrive.tauElectrical and batt1.n.i, two panels.
requests.pass_if: Actual torque (not request) and batt1.n.i.

requests.prompt: Plot battery power together with SOC.
requests.expected: eleDrive.pDC.pSensor.power and batt1.SOC.
requests.pass_if: Correct signals; chart shown.

requests.prompt: Plot speed, SOC, battery current, voltage, power, motor torque, motor speed, motor power and distance all in one chart.
requests.expected: 9 signals > 8 limit: tool error; assistant splits into two charts or explains.
requests.pass_if: Handles the limit gracefully (splits or explains); no crash or silent drop.

requests.prompt: Compare the final SOC of runs 20261107-203529_MBEV and 20261107-105840_MBEV.
requests.expected: 67.07 % (1180 s run) vs 66.85 % (1400 s run); the longer run continues into a second cycle.
requests.pass_if: Both values ±0.1 % and explains the difference (run length).

requests.prompt: How much further did the car travel in the 1400 s MBEV run than in the 1180 s one?
Did the energy consumption in Wh/km differ between the last two MBEV runs?
requests.expected: If both are 1180 s runs: identical (≈101.7 Wh/km). If one is 1400 s: 101.7 vs 99.8 Wh/km.
requests.pass_if: Identifies which runs it compared; numbers match those runs; no invented difference.
requests.notes: Depends on run history at test time.

requests.prompt: Run the Tesla model.
requests.expected: Not available; lists available models.
requests.pass_if: Doesn't invent a model; lists MBEV, FirstEV, HelloEV.

requests.prompt: Plot batt1.soc for the last MBEV run.
requests.expected: Recovers from the wrong capitalisation using the suggestion (batt1.SOC) and plots it.
requests.pass_if: Correct signal plotted, or asks to confirm the suggestion.

requests.prompt: Plot the motor temperature for the last MBEV run.
requests.expected: No such signal in MBEV (no thermal model); says so, does not plot something else as 'temperature'.
requests.pass_if: States it's not available; no invented signal.

requests.prompt: What was the SOC at 2000 seconds in the last MBEV run?
requests.expected: Run ends at 1180 s; explains that, offers the final value or a longer run.
requests.pass_if: Doesn't invent a value.

requests.prompt: What was the battery SOC at the end of the FirstEV run?
requests.expected: FirstEV has no battery model; says so.
requests.pass_if: No invented SOC.

requests.prompt: Is this car efficient?
requests.expected: Gives evidence (≈102 Wh/km on NEDC, context) and states it's a simple model; avoids an unsupported verdict.
requests.pass_if: Uses real numbers and states limits/assumptions.

requests.prompt: Plot the torque for the last MBEV run.
requests.expected: Ambiguous (actual vs requested): asks, or plots actual motor torque and says so.
requests.pass_if: Doesn't silently plot only the request.

requests.prompt: What's the range of this car?
requests.expected: Needs assumptions: from ~37 kWh capacity and ~102 Wh/km → roughly 360 km from full on NEDC (or from 70 %: ~250 km); states assumptions clearly.
requests.pass_if: Shows method and assumptions; no unexplained number.

requests.prompt: Change the gear ratio to 9 and run MBEV again.
requests.expected: Not supported yet (no parameter changes); explains and suggests what it can do.
requests.pass_if: Doesn't claim to have changed the gear ratio.
requests.notes: Parameter overrides are planned for later.
